summary.text: Customers find these artificial leaves look like real ones and come in an assortment of colors, with one customer noting several pretty different shades. The product receives positive feedback for its quality, functionality, and value for money, with customers saying it's worth the price and works perfectly for their projects. The size receives mixed reviews - while some love it, others find them too small for practical use.

insights.title: Quality
insights.summary: Customers find the artificial leaves to be of good quality and highly recommend them.

examples.snippet: I was worried that they were going to be too small but they were perfect! My bf decorated for us for Halloween of last year and they looked amazing....
Great , package came quick , it had alittle smell but I left the bag open for 3 days and the smell disappeared
Nice and authentic looking leaves. I pulled them apart and put them in a laundry basket outside to air out for a day. I'd buy them again.
These leaves are very nice. Packaged separately. Good quality.

insights.title: Appearance
insights.summary: Customers find that the artificial leaves look amazing and exactly as pictured, with one customer noting they provide a nice variety for a more natural appearance.

examples.snippet: These are beautiful but the smell was awful. I opened each package of the different colors. Every one of them had a foul smell to them....
pretty but smell like fish
was fun to decorate worked great and so pretty
It's actually cute and just the right size!...

insights.title: Color
insights.summary: Customers like the artificial leaves' colors, with one mentioning they have several pretty different shades.

examples.snippet: Exactly the correct size for my project. Very colorful. Lots of leaves to peel away, though. Takes a good amount of time to separate them....
Colorful and plentiful. Used for decorating around pumpkin display and for search for spider game,
Wonderful. Beautiful colors, lifelike, a real decorative find for Fall. They come like post it note pads. You tear off how much you want.
Perfect for the autumn party decorations. Great colors.

insights.title: Value for money
insights.summary: Customers find these artificial maple leaves to be worth their price, with several mentioning they would purchase them again, and one noting the quality is surprisingly good for the cost.

examples.snippet: Great value!!!
These leaves are very nice at a great price. There are a variety of nice fall colors....
...Yes, I would purchase again.
...Fairly realistic good color good size quality wise though you get what you pay for so if you are looking for hyper realistic leaves this isn’t it

insights.title: Functionality
insights.summary: Customers are satisfied with the functionality of these artificial leaves, working perfectly for various projects, with one customer noting they are suitable for outdoor use and another mentioning they can be reused and spray painted.

examples.snippet: I used these in a sensory bin as i work with kids. They worked great! They had a bit of a smell when i opened the bag, but quickly went away

This was an awesome product! I used them for photo shoots and they worked PERFECTLY!!! However this product came in smelling like dead fish!!...

insights.title: Leaves
insights.summary: Customers like these artificial leaves, with one customer noting they come in 6 different varieties.

...There are so many leaves so its perfect!...
